title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers reunite to avenge their father's humiliation and murder by Thakur, plotting to marry his daughters as part of a calculated plan to settle scores.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.

title: Code Name: Tiranga
desc: An undercover agent sets out to avenge the 2001 terrorist attacks on Indian soil, but her pursuit of justice soon leads her to a dangerous point of no return.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.

title: Joggers Park
desc: Jenny, a confident and independent 30-year-old woman, sees her life suddenly change when a former judge falls in love with her, challenging her beliefs and outlook.

title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsession destroys Salma's family and shatters her mind. Years later, her sons Iqbal and Sunny unite to rescue her from his captivity and confront their dark past.

title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
desc: Ganga, a kind-hearted villager raised by foster parents, returns to his biological family in the city but struggles to adjust to modern life and its contrasting values.

title: Badla
desc: Naina, a successful entrepreneur, is accused when her lover dies mysteriously. She hires a renowned lawyer to uncover the truth and clear her name in this tense legal battle.

title: Karma
desc: To avenge an insult, a terrorist kills a jailer's family. Seeking revenge, the jailer enlists three death-row inmates to help him carry out his daring plan.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Lakshya
desc: Karan, a carefree youth, joins the Army but quits facing its hardships. When his actions strain his relationship, he returns determined to prove his courage and earn respect.

title: Chintu Ka Birthday
desc: An immigrant family in Iraq faces chaos when soldiers storm their home during a birthday celebration, exposing them to the harsh realities of conflict and fear.
